terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A seaside tower windmill without any sails: a round grey stone base, a white plastered tapered tower with dark timber ribs and a small amber window, a terracotta red cap roof, a short round wooden axle hub sticking straight out of the front of the cap, no sails, no blades, no arms, nothing attached to the hub. Photograph of a real hand-painted wooden toy: carved and lathe-turned hardwood with smooth satin enamel paint, visible wood grain and soft brush strokes, chunky rounded toy proportions, tilt-shift macro product photography, soft warm daylight. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
